[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended artists similar to Bon Iver:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. S. Carey: Former member of Bon Iver's live band, shares a similar atmospheric quality.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Volcano Choir: Another project featuring Justin Vernon (Bon Iver), explores similar soundscapes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. James Blake: Soulful, electronic-infused indie-folk sound shares similarities with Bon Iver's experimental tracks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Ben Howard: British singer-songwriter with intricate fingerpicking and emotive vocals reminiscent of Bon Iver.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. The Antlers: Focus on atmospheric soundscapes and introspective lyrics, often compared to Bon Iver.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended artists similar to Fleet Foxes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Beirut: Eclectic, world-music-inspired indie-folk sound shares similarities with Fleet Foxes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Grizzly Bear: Harmony-driven indie-rock sound often compared to Fleet Foxes' experimental work.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. The Tallest Man on Earth: Swedish singer-songwriter with intricate fingerpicking and poetic lyrics.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. The Lumineers: Acoustic-driven sound and heartfelt lyrics, a good fit for Fleet Foxes fans.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. The Head and the Heart: Shares similarities with Fleet Foxes' harmony-rich sound and eclectic instrumentation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Other notable mentions:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Mumford & Sons: More energetic and anthemic, shares a similar folk-rock spirit.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. The Avett Brothers: Blend of introspective lyrics and catchy, rootsy instrumentation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. First Aid Kit: Swedish folk-pop duo with lush harmonies and introspective sound.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. The Staves: British folk-pop trio with intricate harmonies and a blend of folk, rock, and pop influences.
